text: Because the decentralized economy currently lacks many of the civil institutions available in the larger economy, the average person should not invest anything in the crypto economy.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216
abstract: Since the de- centralized economy is currently lacking in many of the civil institutions that we enjoy in the larger economy, the average person should not invest anything in the crypto economy.
